Task:

  "title": "Duplicate webhook delivery with bounded retention",
  "brief": "A service receives partner webhook events. A partner can redeliver the same event ID for seven days, and a crash may occur between applying an update and acknowledging delivery. The service currently sometimes applies an update twice.",
  "constraints": [
    "The database supports atomic transactions and unique keys.",
    "Keep durable deduplication data within 2 GB; event IDs average 64 bytes and at most one million unique events arrive in seven days.",
    "Events for the same entity can arrive out of order and contain a monotonic entity revision.",
    "No transaction can include the partner's acknowledgement operation."
  ],
  "success_criteria": [
    "Redeliveries do not repeat the business update.",
    "An old revision does not overwrite a newer state.",
    "Specify a crash/replay test and retention behavior at the seven-day boundary."
  ],
  "non_goals": [
    "Assuming exactly-once transport or changing the partner protocol."
  ]
}
